name: lunelle
title: Lunelle's sounds
about: The patches and kits Lunelle ships, for any project to reference as lunelle:<id>: keys, bass, leads, synths, orchestra, guitars, mallets and percussion, four kits of patches and two sampled kits. A released sound never changes within a major version.
author: BinaryVibrance
licence: MIT; the sampled kits' own licences are in their folders

bright.about: Opens a filter: duller at 0, brighter at 1

sweep.about: Moves a filter across a section
